name: Keith Mays
occupation: President and owner, EWS North America

bio.statement: The City of Sherwood council page lists Keith Mays as Councilor, with a term expiring January 2027.
His city bio says he was Sherwood's mayor from 2018 to 2022.
bio.excerpt: Councilor Mays most recently served as Mayor of Sherwood from 2018-2022

bio.statement: His city bio says he served as Council President from 2001 to 2004.
bio.excerpt: He also served as Council President from 2001-2004.

bio.statement: A Pamplin Media article describes Mays as president and owner of EWS North America, a Beaverton-headquartered business.
bio.excerpt: president and owner of EWS North America
